posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
running a company nowadays feels kinda dystopian

my team is 50+ people in 12 countries, but i talk to my agents more than my human teammates

- voice note to grokbot
- mattpocock/skills /grill-me so the agent interrogates the idea before anything gets built
- spec drops into linear through the linear mcp
- exa + firecrawl agent reads every competitor site, pricing page and changelog
- https://t.co/a5ARFnvSnA to find ideas and trends
- apify pulls g2, reddit and app store reviews
- prompt: "find the 10 complaints that show up most and quote the users"
- context7 so the agent reads the latest docs before it touches any api

the design

- claude code + paper mcp
- 4 versions of every screen before a single line of code
- pick pieces from 2, it merges them. diverge then converge
- frontend-design skill from anthropic/skills + our own design system skill
- cleanshot screenshots of any ui i like go straight in with "make it feel like this"

the build

- pingdotgg/t3code as the control surface for every agent, from my phone too
- stablyai/orca runs a fleet of agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree
- graphify maps the whole codebase into a knowledge graph so agents navigate instead of guess
- headroom compresses tool outputs before they hit the model, so tokens go 20-95% further
- lsp plugins so the agent sees types and errors like an ide does
- security guidance hook flags risky edits before they land
- supabase mcp for the database, stripe for billing
- github mcp opens the pr, vercel spins up a preview
- loops run overnight, i check what shipped over coffee

the user testing

- lightpanda as the headless browser, way lighter than chromium so you can run hundreds at once
- agents click every flow on the preview like a first-time user
- one persona is impatient, one is confused, one is on a phone
- playwright + chrome devtools mcp for regression tests

the bugs

- sentry mcp catches the error
- agent reads the stack trace and opens a fix pr in under 10 minutes
- human just approves

the data

- posthog mcp cron at 7am on yesterday's funnel
- any step that drops more than 10%, the agent watches 20 session replays and tells me why
- stripe mcp pulls every cancellation reason into one doc every monday

the agents' tools

- orgo so every agent gets its own computer
- agentmail so every agent gets its own inbox
- agentphone so i can call them from the car
- composio connect-apps for every other connector
- akitaonrails/ai-memory, a git-backed markdown wiki so they remember what we decided last week

the skills

- wshobson/agents so skills work across claude code, codex and opencode
- my writing voice
- our design system
- how we write specs
- skill creator so the agents write new skills themselves

some helpful tricks

- one agent per platform. the x agent never touches email
- cheap model for triage, opus for anything that ships
- every output gets scored 1-10 by an llm judge. under 8 goes back
- every agent writes a 5-line log at night so i can read the whole company in 2 minutes
- every agent mistake becomes a new skill, so it only happens once

the team

- humans get version 5, not my voice note which they are happy about lol 
- their job is creative feedback, relationships and telling the agents what they got wrong

a human pm reviews the funnel once a week. this reviews it every morning

running a company is now voice notes and inference
posts.text_zh:
如今经营一家公司感觉有点反乌托邦

我的团队有 50 多人、分布在 12 个国家，但我跟我的 agent 说话比跟人类同事还多

- 给 grokbot 发语音备忘
- 用 mattpocock/skills 的 /grill-me，让 agent 在动手构建前先把这个想法盘问一遍
- spec 通过 linear mcp 直接落进 linear
- exa + firecrawl 的 agent 读遍每个竞品的网站、定价页和更新日志
- 用 https://t.co/a5ARFnvSnA（ideabrowser.com）找点子和趋势
- apify 抓取 g2、reddit 和 app store 的评论
- 提示词："找出出现最多的 10 条抱怨，并引用用户原话"
- context7，让 agent 在碰任何 api 之前先读最新文档

设计

- claude code + paper mcp
- 每个页面先出 4 个版本，再写一行代码
- 从其中 2 个里挑部分，让它合并。先发散再收敛
- 用 anthropic/skills 里的 frontend-design skill + 我们自己的设计系统 skill
- 看到喜欢的 ui 就用 cleanshot 截图，直接丢进去说"做成这种感觉"

构建

- 用 pingdotgg/t3code 作为所有 agent 的控制台，手机上也能用
- stablyai/orca 并行跑一队 agent，每个都在自己的 git worktree 里
- graphify 把整个代码库映射成知识图谱，让 agent 按图导航而不是瞎猜
- headroom 在工具输出喂给模型之前先压缩，让 token 多撑 20-95%
- lsp 插件让 agent 像 ide 一样看到类型和报错
- 安全指引 hook 在高风险修改落地前就标记出来
- 数据库用 supabase mcp，计费用 stripe
- github mcp 开 pr，vercel 起一个预览环境
- 循环任务通宵跑，我边喝咖啡边看昨晚上线了什么

用户测试

- 用 lightpanda 做无头浏览器，比 chromium 轻得多，能同时跑几百个
- agent 像第一次来的用户一样点遍预览环境里的每个流程
- 一个人设没耐心，一个人设很困惑，一个人设在用手机
- playwright + chrome devtools mcp 做回归测试

bug

- sentry mcp 捕获报错
- agent 读堆栈，10 分钟内开出修复 pr
- 人只需要点批准

数据

- 每天早上 7 点 posthog mcp 定时分析昨天的漏斗
- 任何一步流失超过 10%，agent 就去看 20 段会话回放并告诉我原因
- 每周一 stripe mcp 把所有取消订阅原因汇总到一份文档

agent 的工具

- orgo，让每个 agent 都有自己的电脑
- agentmail，让每个 agent 都有自己的邮箱
- agentphone，让我开车时也能给它们打电话
- composio connect-apps 搞定其他所有连接器
- akitaonrails/ai-memory，一个基于 git 的 markdown wiki，让它们记得我们上周定了什么

skills

- wshobson/agents，让 skills 在 claude code、codex 和 opencode 之间通用
- 我的写作风格
- 我们的设计系统
- 我们写 spec 的方式
- skill creator，让 agent 自己写新 skill

一些好用的技巧

- 一个平台一个 agent。负责 x 的 agent 从不碰邮件
- 分诊用便宜模型，要上线的东西一律用 opus
- 每个产出都由 llm 评委打 1-10 分，低于 8 分打回
- 每个 agent 每晚写 5 行日志，我 2 分钟就能读完整个公司
- agent 犯的每个错都变成一个新 skill，所以同样的错只犯一次

团队

- 人类拿到的是第 5 版，而不是我的语音备忘，他们对此很开心 lol
- 他们的工作是给创意反馈、维护关系，以及告诉 agent 哪里做错了

人类 pm 每周看一次漏斗，而这套东西每天早上都看

经营公司现在就是语音备忘加推理

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
💸 Update: My total biz expenses have now dropped to just ~$300/mo!

This is to run all my websites/apps serving per year:
- 20,000 paying customers
- 252 million visitors
- 2.4 billion requests
- 2.4 petabyte (PB) in bandwidth

(~$8,000/mo if you add the $7,000/mo GPU bill and $800/mo R2 storage I pay for Photo AI, I exclude it above because it's one project that's so much more expensive in size than all the other sites together, but included in the chart below)

Claude Code helped me to find smart ways to save more money, AI is just really really really good at finding cost savings by itself, which is not so great for the economy short-term, but long term it trims all the fat and opens up spending for better investments I think

Anyway here's what it saved me in money, almost $34,000/mo:

- $29,000/mo - switched to better and cheaper video models on Photo AI, video was very expensive and since I didn't update it ever it stayed expensive, also routed some image jobs to Google Cloud where I have some Google Cloud Credits, and also routed some jobs to Sume which sells AI models at market cost, very cool! This made my GPU bill go from $36,000/mo to $7,000/mo

- $3,000/mo - consolidated my servers, cancelled Digital Ocean and Linode and moved everything to Hetzner saving about $3,000/mo

- $1100/mo - analyzed my Backblaze B2 server backups, I had infinite versioning and lifecycle policies, that's reduced now to 30 days, this literally pushed the bill from $1,200/mo to $26/mo, about 50x cheaper! I had essentially versions of files for all my servers for over a decade, crazy!

- $400/mo - similarly added Lifecycle Policies to my Cloudflare R2 bucket for Photo AI, pics are automatically put in cheaper Infrequent Access after 90 days, there was years of photos in there so this reduced the R2 bill from $1,200/mo to $800/mo

- $118/mo - Claude analyzed all my Cloudflare Domain registrations, lots of domains I didn't use and didn't make sense to keep paying for, lots of things that also don't really make sense anymore in a post-AGI world, renewals for .io TLD are now $50/year which adds up fast!

- $100/mo - Claude also analyzed my Claude subscription (yes!) and discovered I don't even use the Max 20x plan limits, so I downgraded from $200/mo to $100/mo

Even including Photo AI, I have now cut my costs by 90% from last year, getting me close to my biz expenses amount from a decade ago when I started building things

Costs slowly creep up over the years and you don't realize all the things you're spending on but AI is nice to help you figure all that out (also in your personal life!)
posts.text_zh:
💸 更新：我的业务总开支现在已经降到每月只要约 300 美元！

这是运行我所有网站/应用的费用，每年服务：
- 20,000 名付费用户
- 2.52 亿访客
- 24 亿次请求
- 2.4 PB 带宽

（如果再加上 Photo AI 每月 7,000 美元的 GPU 账单和每月 800 美元的 R2 存储，大约每月 8,000 美元；上面没算进去，是因为这个项目体量远大于其他站点加起来，但下面图表里包含了）

Claude Code 帮我找到了更聪明的省钱办法。AI 自己找成本节约点真的非常非常非常强，短期对经济不太友好，但长期它会剔掉所有赘肉、把开支腾出来做更好的投资，我觉得是这样。

反正它帮我省下的钱差不多每月 34,000 美元：

- 每月 29,000 美元 —— Photo AI 换成更好更便宜的视频模型；视频以前很贵，我又一直没更新，所以一直贵；还把一些图像任务路由到有 Google Cloud Credits 的 Google Cloud，以及路由到按市价卖 AI 模型的 Sume，很酷！GPU 账单从每月 36,000 降到 7,000

- 每月 3,000 美元 —— 合并服务器，取消 Digital Ocean 和 Linode，全部迁到 Hetzner，大约省 3,000/月

- 每月 1,100 美元 —— 分析 Backblaze B2 服务器备份：以前无限版本+生命周期策略，现在缩到 30 天，账单从 1,200/月 literal 降到 26/月，大约便宜 50 倍！我等于存了所有服务器十多年的文件版本，疯了

- 每月 400 美元 —— 同样给 Photo AI 的 Cloudflare R2 加了 Lifecycle Policies，图片 90 天后自动进更便宜的 Infrequent Access；里面有好几年的照片，R2 账单从 1,200/月降到 800/月

- 每月 118 美元 —— Claude 分析了我全部 Cloudflare 域名注册，很多不用了、没必要续的域名；后 AGI 时代很多东西也不太说得通了，.io TLD 续费现在一年 50 美元，加起来很快

- 每月 100 美元 —— Claude 还分析了我的 Claude 订阅（是的！），发现我根本没用满 Max 20x 限额，于是从 200/月降到 100/月

即便算上 Photo AI，我今年已经把成本砍掉了 90%，接近十年前刚开始做产品时的业务开支水平。

成本会慢慢爬升，你自己未必察觉在花什么；AI 很适合帮你把这些理清楚（个人生活也一样！）
